title: ACM Meta-Schema
description: Constraints on the ACM schema itself (constitution I): declares the ACM annotation keywords and the top-level shape. Exhaustive per-field enforcement (every specified field typed, described, tiered; acmApplicability only on CEM-inherited nodes) is performed by the meta walker in packages/toolchain/src/meta.ts; both run in the gate-schema suite.

acmTier.description: Provenance tier annotation keyword: every specified field carries exactly one.

acmApplicability.description: Paradigm classes a node applies to; only valid alongside acmCemInherited: true.

acmCemInherited.description: Marks a CEM-inherited, WC-specific node (constitution VIII grandfather clause).
